🌟 0-CODE | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automate the entire software development lifecycle for AI agents, allowing them to work on tasks autonomously and continuously.
✨ Key Features: • Autonomous development loop for AI agents • Plans, writes, tests, and commits code independently • State survives restarts and continues across sessions • Zero runtime dependencies • External supervisor for OpenCode and internal stop hook for Claude Code
📖 Summary: 0-CODE is an autonomous development loop for AI agents like Claude Code and OpenCode. It enables agents to independently plan, write, test, and commit code, maintaining state and continuing work across sessions without runtime dependencies.
